methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The method for calculating annual energy savings involves evaluating the difference between the energy consumption before the implementation of the optimization action and the future energy consumption after applying the energy saving strategy. The annual energy savings associated with the implementation of an action can be expressed by equation 5 [20].

paper_type.evidence_quote: This study, conducted in an office building located in Morocco, presents a concrete methodology for optimizing energy consumption in buildings at the national level. The work implements an advanced approach integrating an energy management system and photovoltaic installations, with a comparison of the result obtained from a real case study with similar research conducted internationally.
